settings.title: Settings Center
settings.subtitle: Configure detectors, LLM providers, agent defense strategies, and system parameters.
settings.detectors.desc: Three-level monitoring pipeline: L1 heuristic → L2 semantic → L3 LLM intent analysis
settings.l1.enabled.desc: Enable or disable the L1 regex heuristic detector
settings.l1.action.desc: Action taken when a regex pattern matches
settings.l2.threshold.desc: Minimum cosine similarity to flag a semantic match (lower = more aggressive)
settings.l2.topK.desc: Number of nearest neighbors queried from the vector store
settings.l2.minMatches.desc: Minimum results above threshold required to trigger detection
settings.l2.autoCalibrate.desc: Dynamically tune per-injection-type thresholds based on observed precision/recall
settings.l3.enabled.desc: Enable or disable LLM-based intent analysis
settings.l3.selfConsistency.desc: Sample LLM multiple times with temperature jitter and take majority vote
settings.l3.votes.desc: Number of independent LLM calls for self-consistency check (1-5)
settings.pipeline.fusionThreshold.desc: Compound confidence threshold for multi-detector Bayesian fusion
settings.pipeline.shortCircuit.desc: Stop after first block instead of running all detectors (fail-fast)
settings.pipeline.logAll.desc: Include skipped and non-blocking detection results in event metadata
settings.pipeline.minSeverity.desc: Only invoke the LLM detector when event severity reaches this level
settings.honeypot.grayLow.desc: Lower bound of gray zone — confidences in [low, high) are routed to honeypot
settings.honeypot.grayHigh.desc: Upper bound of gray zone — confidences above this are confirmed threats
settings.llm.desc: Configure the large language model used by detectors and agents
settings.llm.enabled.desc: Global toggle for all LLM-powered features (detectors, auditor, red team, honeypot)
settings.llm.temperature.desc: Controls output randomness (0 = deterministic, 2 = max creativity)
settings.llm.timeout.desc: Max seconds to wait for each LLM API call
settings.agents.desc: Configure multi-agent joint defense: auditor reputation, red team attacks, honeypot decoys
settings.auditor.initial.desc: Starting reputation score for each monitored agent (0-1)
settings.auditor.blockThreshold.desc: Reputation below this value triggers immediate blocking (skip challenge)
settings.auditor.decayInterval.desc: Seconds without incidents before time-based recovery activates
settings.auditor.decayRate.desc: Reputation recovered per decay interval period
settings.redTeam.enabled.desc: Enable automated internal red team that generates adversarial attack payloads
settings.redTeam.interval.desc: Seconds between consecutive red team attacks
settings.redTeam.maxAttacks.desc: Maximum number of attacks per activation cycle
settings.honeypot.enabled.desc: Enable the honeypot agent for gray-zone intelligence gathering
settings.honeypot.node.desc: The agent node ID that serves as the honeypot decoy target
settings.system.desc: Platform-level settings: CORS, event retention, WebSocket
settings.system.cors.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for cross-origin requests
settings.system.retention.desc: Maximum number of events retained in the database
